name: MonarchKeyValue
title: KeyValue
wrapsNative: MonarchFlowLayout (a SwiftUI Layout) or VStack of Text pairs, with MonarchCopyButton
summary: Compact metadata as label and value pairs, such as "Region eu-west · Plan Team · ID 4f2a…", that wrap or stack, with optional copy buttons.
whenToUse: For a few facts under a title or inside a card: region, plan, id, owner.
whenNotToUse: For a grid of many facts on a detail page, use Form with LabeledContent. For one status, use MonarchBadge or MonarchStatusBadge.
api: init(_ items: [MonarchKeyValueItem], separator: MonarchKeyValueSeparator = .dot, size: MonarchKeyValueSize = .sm, layout: MonarchKeyValueLayout = .wrap, emptyLabel: String? = nil, onCopy: (@MainActor (String) -> Void)? = nil)
MonarchKeyValueItem.init(_ label: String, value: String?, isCopyable: Bool = false, copyValue: String? = nil, isMonospaced: Bool = false)
enum MonarchKeyValueSeparator { case dot, divider, none }

options.name: separator
options.description: dot, divider or none, between pairs in the wrap layout.

options.name: size
options.description: sm uses caption text, md body text.

options.name: layout
options.description: wrap flows pairs onto more lines; stack puts each pair on its own line.

options.name: emptyLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in "Not set" spoken for an empty value.

options.name: onCopy
options.description: Runs with the copied text after a copy button is used.

options.name: MonarchKeyValueItem.value
options.description: The value; nil or empty shows a dash.

options.name: MonarchKeyValueItem.isCopyable
options.description: Adds a copy button that copies the value.

options.name: MonarchKeyValueItem.copyValue
options.description: Adds a copy button that copies this text instead, such as the full id behind a shortened one.

options.name: MonarchKeyValueItem.isMonospaced
options.description: Draws the value in the code face.

states.name: empty value
states.description: The value is a dash in the subtle text colour, read as "Not set"; no copy button.

states.name: copied
states.description: The copy button shows a check mark for two seconds and announces "Copied to clipboard" (MonarchCopyButton).

appearance: Labels in the muted text colour and values in the default text colour, in caption or body type. The dot separator uses the subtle text colour and the divider the default border colour.
platformNotes: The web has KeyValue and KeyValueItem as a container and children with any content as the value; here the pairs are values with text, so separators and copy buttons are placed by the component. Android shares the name and the options.
accessibility: Each pair is one element: the key is the label and the value is the value, so they are read together.
An empty value is drawn as a dash and read as "Not set".
A copy button is a separate element named "Copy" and the key, with a 44-point touch target.
Text scales with Dynamic Type; long values wrap and pairs move to the next line.
edgeCases: In the wrap layout a separator starts the line when a pair wraps, as on the web.
A pair with a copy button is at least 44 points high, so a wrapping line with one is taller than one without.

examples.title: Metadata line
examples.template:
MonarchKeyValue([
    MonarchKeyValueItem({{items.0.label}}, value: {{items.0.value}}),
    MonarchKeyValueItem({{items.1.label}}, value: {{items.1.value}}),
    MonarchKeyValueItem({{items.2.label}}, value: {{items.2.value}}),
])
examples.code:
MonarchKeyValue([
    MonarchKeyValueItem("Region", value: "eu-west"),
    MonarchKeyValueItem("Plan", value: "Team"),
    MonarchKeyValueItem("Seats", value: "24"),
])

examples.title: One pair per line in a narrow card
